title: 第3章
content_zh: 初到异世 003，家里从县上到村子距离不远，却也不近，赶着驴车吱吱呀呀的两个小时便到。一路上，老马头给苏涟漪讲了所有她想知道的，于是，想摔下驴车的不再是老马头而是苏涟漪了。原来，这身子本尊真的是女恶棍，所住的村子叫苏家村，顾名思义，村民差不多都姓苏，是一个本家。本应因此和睦相处，但相反，村里人都怕他们家。苏涟漪的爹——苏峰，便是有名的恶棍，欺凌弱小，村里人惹不起他便干脆躲着他。苏峰有三个孩子，大儿子苏皓，继承了自家爷爷的手艺，开了小酒厂，算是家里唯一可以讲理之人。老二便是她苏涟漪，别看她是个女娃，闹起事来，比男娃还要混账，而苏峰却认为二女儿最像他，甚是宠爱，于是，村里人对苏涟漪只能忍气吞声。三儿子苏白，也不是个好东西，却有贼心没贼胆，平日里跟着他混账二姐混，算是苏涟漪的左膀右臂。苏涟漪确实是嫁了，是老爹苏峰包办的婚姻。男人，是苏峰从山里捡来的，面貌丑陋，也许是脑子有些问题，整整一天天也憋不出几句话，但身强力壮，苏峰便让男人做了倒插门女婿，整日下田种庄稼，只当多个奴隶。别看苏涟漪本尊貌丑、体胖，但却眼高于顶，认为自己的夫君要貌若潘安，对这段婚姻自然是不满意的，可惜小胳膊拧不过大腿，只能暂时作罢。李家是岳望县首富，有两子。老大李玉兰考取了功名，走上了仕途之路，加之娶了从二品礼部尚书之女，如今前途光明，是李家的骄傲。二公子李玉棠，貌美聪颖，李家想培养他经商，接手家族产业，自然也是寄予厚望。苏涟漪本尊便是看上了二公子的容貌，几次三番跑去求爱，最后就这么莫名其妙的死了。苏涟漪家与苏峰家是分开的，不住在一起，平日里本尊便对丑陋夫君连打带骂，甚至有几次当街用鞭子抽自己夫君。那男人也许真是傻的，也不躲，就站在街中央任她抽打，直到她累了作罢才好。老马头讲完，苏涟漪震惊，长大了嘴。她做梦也想不到，上辈子是救死扶伤的医生，这辈子竟成了女恶棍流氓？不仅仅如此，让她震惊的还有这个国家，或者说，这个时空。这个国家名为鸾国，是整片大陆数一数二的大国。苏涟漪是理科生，历史不好，但就算是再差的历史成绩也知道，这鸾国根本不在中国五千年的历史范畴之中。除了鸾国，还有赵国、青山国等，涟漪敢肯定，这肯定不是她记忆中的中国古代。借尸还魂了，穿越了，竟然穿越到了一个架空的世界。老马头讲完，便专心赶路，只留苏涟漪自己慢慢消化刚刚所听到的一切。她隐约记得有一种学说，在与世界平行的位面，还有多个不同的世界同时存在，难道……这不是猜想，而是真的？小驴车吱嘎吱嘎入了村，村头人看到是苏皓家的驴车，都暗暗发出鄙夷的目光——苏涟漪那癞蛤蟆想必又去肖想吃天鹅肉了吧，可笑。大家的鄙夷不约而同，却没人敢直白白表现出来，毕竟这女混球什么都干得出来，犯浑不讲理。“涟漪，你家到了。”驴车停下，老马头道。涟漪从沉思中清醒，转头一看，一旁是一个院子，院子当中是房屋，可以看出无论是院子还是房屋都是新修的，可惜，主人并不爱惜，杂草丛生不说，到处都是垃圾，将新房子弄得破烂不堪。“涟漪？”老马头又唤了一声，后来想起她说脑子有些不清明，解释道，“这就是你家，这个时间，估计大虎下田回来了，正在家等你呢罢。”涟漪愣愣的点了点头，“知道了，马大叔辛苦了。”虽然这么回答，但还是仿佛身在梦里，没有丝毫真实感。一个闪身，下了车。虽然苏涟漪胖，但腿脚灵活，可能因为本尊也是个打架好手罢。老马头赶着驴车离开，他还得回去为东家报账。天色暗了，涟漪站在门口好一阵，也没勇气走进去。她就这么……穿越了？就这么嫁人了？以后就要当个村姑女流氓了？无奈笑着叹了口气，推开了虚掩的院门，走了进去。前世在医院中，见了太多求生而不能之人，才更体会到生命的可贵。活着便比死了好，既然老天让她活着，她便要好好的活，生命还在继续。进了院子，便能闻到一股霉味，原来是院子一旁堆满了脏衣服，衣服长时间不洗便散发出刺鼻的味道，素来稍有洁癖的涟漪闻后，差点没呛晕过去。好歹穿过了院子入了房子，打开了房门，还没向内走，便硬生生被呛得倒退几步——这屋内的味儿比屋外更烈！涟漪有种想死得冲动，觉得若是在这房子里住，定然生不如死。大大喘了几口气，而后屏住呼吸跑了进去，用最快的速度将所有窗子打开。悲催的，真不知这本尊是怎么活的，好好的春天，窗子竟然关得死紧，根据窗棱上积压的尘土看，这窗子最少一年没开过了，难道……夏天也要关窗子过？成功开了两个窗子后，第三个窗子怎么也打不开。涟漪的肺活量很大，但最终还是用完，被迫喘了口气，刺鼻的垃圾味冲入肺部，连连干呕。最后她忍无可忍，向后退了几步，一个箭步冲上来，威猛回旋踢，终于将窗子破坏性打开。清新的空气流入室内，她这才忍住想呕的欲望。屋子破烂不堪，在正中央有一桌子，桌子料子不错，厚实的木板，一圈还雕了些许花纹。因为苏涟漪本尊有个疼爱她的爹和大哥，想必这些家具都是两人给置办的。桌子上也满是厚厚的尘土，比厚重尘土更可怕的是，上面竟然有些年久的油污，在油污上，还有一些很奇怪的物体。涟漪忍住恶心，将那物体捏起，竟然是……菜叶！还是不知猴年马月的菜叶！有人说，人的忍耐力是有限的，此时此刻，苏涟漪却否认了这个看法——人的忍耐力是无限的！本以为看到这些菜叶，有洁癖的她能吐出来，但相反，非但没吐，还冷静了下来。－－－－－－题外话－－－－－－请大家起立，摘帽，用我们最热烈的掌声迎接男主的到来~~~~~
content_en: When I first arrived in another world 003, the distance from the county to the village was not far, but it was not close either. It took two hours to drive a donkey cart to get there. Along the way, Lao Ma Tou told Su Lianyi everything she wanted to know. As a result, it was no longer Lao Ma Tou who wanted to fall off the donkey cart but Su Lianyi. It turns out that the deity in this body is really a female villain. The village where she lives is called Sujiacun. As the name suggests, almost all the villagers are named Su, and they belong to the same family. They should have lived in harmony because of this, but on the contrary, everyone in the village was afraid of their family. Su Lianyi's father, Su Feng, was a well-known villain who bullied the weak. People in the village simply avoided him if they couldn't afford to offend him. Su Feng has three children. The eldest son, Su Hao, inherited his grandfather's craftsmanship and opened a small winery. He is the only reasonable person in the family. The second child was her, Su Lianyi. Even though she was a girl, she was even more troublesome than the boys. However, Su Feng thought that the second daughter was the most like him and loved him very much. Therefore, the villagers could only swallow their anger towards Su Lianyi. The third son, Su Bai, is not a good guy either, but he has a thief heart but no courage. He usually hangs out with his bastard second sister, and is Su Lianyi's right-hand man. Su Lianyi was indeed married. It was a marriage arranged by her father, Su Feng. The man was picked up from the mountains by Su Feng. He had an ugly face and maybe some brain problems. He couldn't hold back a few words for a whole day. However, he was strong, so Su Feng made the man his son-in-law. He worked in the fields all day long and worked as a slave. Although Su Lianyi is ugly and fat, she has her eyes set high above her head. She thinks that her husband should be as beautiful as Pan An, so she is naturally dissatisfied with this marriage. Unfortunately, her small arms cannot twist her thighs, so she can only give up temporarily. The Li family is the richest man in Yuewang County and has two sons. The eldest, Li Yulan, obtained the imperial examination and embarked on an official career. In addition, she married the daughter of a second-rank minister of the Ministry of Etiquette. She now has a bright future and is the pride of the Li family. The second son, Li Yutang, was beautiful and intelligent. The Li family wanted to train him to do business and take over the family business, so naturally they had high hopes. Su Lianyi was attracted by the appearance of the second young master, so she went to court him several times, and finally died inexplicably. Su Lianyi's family and Su Feng's family are separate and do not live together. On weekdays, I beat and scold the ugly husband, and even whipped my husband in the street a few times. Maybe the man was really stupid, he didn't hide away, he just stood in the middle of the street and let her beat her until she got tired and gave up. After Lao Ma Tou finished speaking, Su Lianyi was shocked and opened her mouth. She never dreamed that in her previous life she was a doctor who saved lives and healed the wounded, but in this life she would become a female villain and gangster? Not only that, what shocked her was this country, or rather, this time and space. This country is called Luan Country, and it is one of the largest countries in the entire continent. Su Lianyi is a science student and is not good at history, but even with poor history scores, she knows that this Luan country is not included in China's five thousand years of history. In addition to Luan Kingdom, there are also Zhao Kingdom, Qingshan Kingdom, etc. Lianyi is sure that this is definitely not the ancient China in her memory. The borrowed corpse came back to life, and he traveled through time, and actually traveled to an imaginary world. After Lao Ma Tou finished speaking, he concentrated on his way, leaving Su Lianyi to slowly digest everything she just heard. She vaguely remembered that there was a theory that in a plane parallel to the world, there were multiple different worlds existing at the same time. Could it be that... this was not a conjecture, but a reality? The donkey cart creaked into the village. When the village leaders saw that it was the donkey cart belonging to Su Hao's family, they secretly looked at her with disdain - Su Lianyi's toad must have gone to Xiaoxiang to eat swan meat again. It's ridiculous. Everyone's disdain was unanimous, but no one dared to express it openly. After all, this female bastard could do anything and was unreasonable. "Lianyi, your home has arrived." The donkey cart stopped and Old Ma Tou said. Ripple woke up from his meditation and turned around to look. There was a yard to the side, and in the middle of the yard was a house. It could be seen that both the yard and the house were newly built. Unfortunately, the owner did not take care of it. Not only were weeds overgrown, but there were garbage everywhere, making the new house dilapidated. "Lianyi?" Lao Ma Tou called again, then remembered that she said her mind was a little unclear, and explained, "This is your home. At this time, Dahu has probably returned from the fields and is waiting for you at home." Lianyi nodded blankly, "I know, thank you for your hard work, Uncle Ma." Although he answered like this, it was still as if he was in a dream, without any sense of reality. He ducked and got out of the car. Although Su Lianyi is fat, her legs and feet are flexible, maybe because she is also a good fighter. Old Ma Tou drove the donkey cart away, and he had to go back to pay the bills to his employer. It was getting dark, and Lianyi stood at the door for a while, not having the courage to go in. She just... traveled through time? Just get married like this? Are you going to be a village girl and a gangster from now on? Smiling helplessly and sighing, he pushed open the ajar door and walked in. In my previous life in the hospital, I saw too many people who were desperate for survival, and I realized the preciousness of life even more. Living is better than dying. Since God allows her to live, she must live well and life will continue. Entering the yard, you can smell a musty smell. It turns out that there are piles of dirty clothes on the side of the yard. The clothes give out a pungent smell if they are not washed for a long time. After smelling it, Liang Li, who has always been a bit of a germaphobe, almost choked and fainted. I finally crossed the yard and entered the house, opened the door, and before I could go inside, I was choked and forced to take a few steps back - the smell inside the house was stronger than outside! Lianyi had the urge to die, feeling that if she lived in this house, life would be worse than death. He took a few deep breaths, then held his breath and ran in, opening all the windows as quickly as possible. It's so sad. I really don't know how this person lives. It's a beautiful spring, but the window is closed tightly. Judging from the accumulation of dust on the window edge, this window hasn't been opened for at least a year. Could it be that... the window has to be closed in summer? After successfully opening two windows, the third window could not be opened. Ripple's lung capacity is very large,
